---
title: "Spike A: hard cases"
format: html
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(crosstalk)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(ggplot2)
source("common.R")

group   <- "cars"
cols    <- c("mpg", "cyl", "disp", "hp", "wt", "gear", "am")
sd_all  <- SharedData$new(mtcars, group = group)
filters <- list(cyl = list(input = "radio", label = "Cylinders"))
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
htmltools::tagList(
  crosstalk::crosstalkLibs(),
  spike_dep("qr-spike-crosstalk", "sink_crosstalk.js"),
  spike_filters(mtcars, group, rownames(mtcars), filters)
)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
plot_ly(sd_all, x = ~mpg, type = "histogram")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
ggplotly(ggplot(sd_all, aes(mpg, hp, colour = factor(cyl))) + geom_point())
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
datatable(SharedData$new(mtcars[mtcars$mpg > 20, cols], group = group))
```
